1. Choose your own Xbox 360 ISO of Naruto: The Broken Bond (no game files are included).

2. Tap Play. The first start takes a while; new areas can stutter once while their graphics are prepared.

3. On-screen controls: left side moves, right side turns the camera, the gear opens PC Options. A Bluetooth or USB controller works too (the on-screen controls hide while one is connected).

4. The back gesture opens a menu to continue, hide the on-screen controls, or quit.

This is an alpha for Snapdragon (Adreno) phones. If it crashes, tap "Save logs for a problem report" and send the zip it saves in Downloads.
These are saved to naruto.toml. In game, PC Options (gear button) has every option. Most graphics options apply on the next start.
